Who we are

PinkRyno Studios is an independent game studio in Florida, USA.

What this policy covers

It covers pinkrynostudios.com and every page on it.

Information we collect

We do not collect personal information through this website. Personal information means information that identifies a person or can reasonably be linked to a person. That includes a name, email address, phone number, photo, voice, precise location, contacts, and an account identifier.

There are no accounts, no sign-up forms, and no profile to fill in. We do not ask a child for any of those things.

Ads, tracking, and SDKs

This website has no ads and no tracking. We do not let anyone else show ads on it, we do not use interest-based advertising, and we do not collect analytics.

It does not use third-party advertising, analytics, attribution, crash-reporting, or social SDKs, and it does not load fonts, pictures, or scripts from any other site.

Purchases

You can't buy anything on this website, and we do not collect payment information.

Cookies and device storage

This website does not set cookies. If one of our games runs in your browser, it saves progress (like stars and settings) on your device, in the browser's storage. That progress is not sent to us or to anyone else. Clearing this site's data in your browser erases it. The parental gate does not save its answer.

Children

This website is directed to children under 13, and parents use it too. We follow the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act by not collecting personal information from children. Because we do not collect it, we do not ask for verifiable parental consent to collect it.

We do not knowingly receive personal information from a child. If you believe we have, email us and we will delete it.

Email you send us

If you email us, we receive whatever you choose to write, and we use it only to reply. Please do not include a child's name, photo, or precise location. We do not add your address to a mailing list. You can ask us to delete the conversation and we will.

How to delete information

We do not have a player profile to delete. To erase game progress, see Cookies and device storage above. To delete emails you sent us, write to us and ask.

Hosting

These pages are static files, and we do not receive a report of who visited them.

The company that hosts the files may keep ordinary technical logs, such as an IP address and the page that was requested, to keep the service secure. We do not use those logs to identify a child, build a profile, or advertise, and we do not combine them with other information.

Changes

If we change this policy, we will update the date at the top of the page.

Contact
